art_instructions: Set a sunny, welcoming front porch of the small cottage centered in the frame, with creamy white wooden walls, sage-green shutters, and a warm terracotta roof edge visible above. The front door is open inward, showing a transition from bright outdoor light to the warm glow of the wooden interior; place a woven basket and a small cream-colored rug just inside on the wooden floor, with a window and soft cream curtains to the right. A short two-step porch leads up from a cobblestone path that enters from the lower left, bordered by low lavender and two tall sunflowers. Position the Owl at the doorway, about one-third of the frame height, mid-step as she enters: her left foot is just over the threshold inside, her right foot still on the sill, to clearly show “entering.” Give her mottled brown-and-cream feathers, round amber eyes, and a small green scarf tied at her neck; a tiny satchel crosses her body and rests at her side as if returning from school. Her wings are slightly spread for balance, head turned toward the interior with a gentle, happy expression. Add soft outdoor shadows falling to the left, while the interior glows warmer, so the viewer can see both the exterior garden and the cozy wood walls and plants inside. Include subtle motion lines behind her to emphasize movement from outside to inside.
